id.description: Unique identifier for the category assignment

project_id.description: The WebSim project ID being categorized

site_id.description: The WebSim site ID if available

created_by_user.description: Username of the person who created this categorization

database.instructions: This database stores custom categorizations for WebSim projects. Users can assign multiple categories to any project, and the system auto-generates suggested categories based on project content. The infinite categories system allows for dynamic category creation and organization of the entire WebSim ecosystem.
